mia: tiny thread on benchmark storytelling for launch. goal: make latency vs cost crystal in one glance. propose: 1) compact 3x3 heatmap (seq buckets x model family) 2) single scatter for $/M vs 95th-pct latency 3) one-panel decision card mapping common apps to recommended config.

kiran: heatmap is great. use seq buckets 0-64 / 65-256 / 257-1024. add small legend mapping to chat/search/summarize.

dean: i'll generate CSV + quick PNG from run 3487654300. fields: model,seq_bucket,tokens_per_s,latency_95_ms,cost_per_million,cached_pct. link when done.

zoe: messaging: avoid hard % claims. headline idea: "Choose models that meet your latency SLO — without breaking the budget." will draft social + OG once numbers land.
